blocks.text: TOLEDO CITY, CEBU — As transboundary haze from fires in Indonesia has affected parts of the Philippines, knowing how air quality is changing at the community level can be just as important as knowing the overall conditions across the region. In Toledo City, Cebu, local officials have access to real-time readings from a monitoring station in Barangay Cabitoonan. The data provides a localized view of particulate levels in the area and can help authorities assess conditions on the ground and provide information that can help guide public health advisories and other local responses as conditions change.
